subtitle: Jobs, turns, leading
question: What is your job in the game?
promise: In this unit you will join a game, take a job in it, and lead one turn yourself. Every job matters.
learn: Join a game without being asked
Take a job: thrower, catcher, collector

title: Three jobs
text: The thrower sends the ball. The catcher waits with two hands ready. The collector keeps the bean bags in the basket. Three jobs, one game.
say: Give every child a job name before the game starts. A child with a job joins in without being asked.

title: How to join in
text: Stand where you can be seen. Wait for a gap. Then say: can I play?
rows: I stood where I could be seen

steps.text: Choose one game. Say the rules out loud.
Show the start line and the finish line.
Say 'go'. Then play with everyone else.

text: Lead one turn of a game. Say the rules, then say go. Ask the others one question afterwards.
A red ball, in the air, for one moment.

title: Listen, then move
text: Listen to the whole instruction first. Then move.
rows: I moved after the word go

lead: Colour one circle for each line. There is no wrong answer here.
rows: I took a job in the game
rescue: If a child will not join in, give them the job of collector and no other words. The job is the invitation.

text: Everyone sits down at the end. The grass is still.
